$meta.name: Sahra design tokens
$meta.note: Single source of truth. Generate per-platform outputs (Dart consts, CSS variables, Tailwind theme) from this file; do not fork values.

night.role: Primary dark. Backgrounds, text on light, primary buttons.

gold.role: Brand signature. The ticket, highlights, CTA on Night.

sand.role: Light background and cards. Replaces pure white.

dune.role: Secondary light surface, dividers, skeleton loaders.

ink.role: Body text on Sand and Dune.

rumman.role: Accent and alerts only: selling fast, errors, live. Use sparingly.

colorRules.darkModeDefault: Event-discovery surfaces are dark (Night). Checkout, account and receipts use light (Sand) for legibility.

display.note: Logo artwork + hero display only. Ruqaa never below 32px, never for body/buttons.

numeric.note: Western numerals by default; Eastern Arabic as a locale setting.

layout.ticketNotchMotif: Only on real ticket objects: Tickets tab cards, order confirmation, QR pass.

motif.clearSpace: notch radius (~10% of ticket width) on every side

voice.tone: Well-connected friend: warm, quick, a little playful. Never corporate.
voice.arabicRegister: Friendly MSA (فصحى مبسطة); light Gulf/Levantine touches allowed in marketing.
